categories.name: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks
categories.content: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks are on-chain tokens that represent economic exposure to traditional stocks, with each token typically backed 1:1 by the underlying security held through a regulated custodian

categories.name: Reality Ecosystem
categories.content: Reality is a platform by Bitget that issues tokenized real-world assets (like U.S. stocks and ETFs) backed 1:1 by securities, bringing them on-chain with stablecoin dividend payments.

categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: Tokenized Silver
categories.content: Tokenized silver refers to digital representation of physical silver on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Commodities Meme
categories.content: Meme projects tied to commodities in traditional finance.

categories.name: Ether.fi Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around Ether.fi.

categories.name: PreStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: PreStocks Ecosystem consists of tokenized pre-IPO stocks offered by PreStocks.

categories.name: Moonshot Ecosystem
categories.content: Moonshot Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via https://moonshot.money/.

categories.name: Tokenized Commodities
categories.content: Tokenized Commodities refers to digital representation of commodities such as oil, gold, silver on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Guild and Scholarship
categories.content: Guilds are decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) that invests in NFTs like game assets and rent them out to players. Players who receive rented game items are known as scholars and can be said to receive a scholarship. Guilds are an important component in the play to earn (P2E) ecosystem as these games require an upfront investment capital for players to participate in.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.
